load_llm_model: load a pretrained LLM model and tokenizer from huggingface or modelscope using llm_load_model
load_mllm_model: load a multimodal LLM model with processor and image processor using mllm_load_model
load_diffusion_model: load a diffusion pipeline model from huggingface using diffusion_load_model
get_block_names: get the block layer names for a transformer or vision language model using get_block_names
set_amax_for_moe: set activation max values for uncalibrated MoE expert layers using set_amax_for_all_moe_layers
